chapter.li: LEChapter1 Verse1 As I am a messenger of Jesus Christ, and knowing that many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us, VerseEnd Verse2 even as they delivered them unto us, who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and ministers of the word, VerseEnd Verse3 it seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto you in order, most excellent Theophilus, VerseEnd Verse4 that you might know the certainty of those things wherein you have been instructed. VerseEnd

Verse5 There was, in the days of Herod the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abijah, and his wife — being of the daughters of Aaron, and her name Elizabeth VerseEnd — Verse6 were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless; VerseEnd Verse7 and they had no child. Elizabeth was barren, and they were both well-stricken in years. VerseEnd

Verse8 And while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his priesthood, VerseEnd Verse9 according to the law — his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord VerseEnd — Verse10 the whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the time of incense. VerseEnd Verse11 And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense. VerseEnd Verse12 And when Zacharias saw the angel, he was troubled and fear fell upon him; VerseEnd Verse13 but the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias, for your prayer is heard, and your wife Elizabeth shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name John. VerseEnd Verse14 You shall have joy and gladness, and many shall rejoice at his birth, VerseEnd Verse15 for he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the holy ghost, even from his mother’s womb. VerseEnd Verse16 And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God. VerseEnd Verse17 And he shall go before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just, to make ready a people prepared for the Lord. VerseEnd

Verse18 And Zacharias said unto the angel, How shall I know this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well-stricken in years. VerseEnd Verse19 And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, who stand in the presence of God, and am sent to speak unto you, and to show you these glad tidings. VerseEnd Verse20 And behold, you shall be dumb and not able to speak until the day that these things shall be performed, because you believed not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season. VerseEnd Verse21 And the people waited for Zacharias, and marveled that he tarried so long in the temple. VerseEnd Verse22 And when he came out he could not speak unto them. And they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple, for he beckoned unto them and remained speechless; VerseEnd Verse23 and as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house. VerseEnd Verse24 And after those days, his wife Elizabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying, VerseEnd Verse25 Thus has the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach from among men. VerseEnd

Verse26 And in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee named Nazareth, VerseEnd Verse27 to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary. VerseEnd Verse28 And the angel came in unto her and said, Hail, virgin, who are highly favored of the Lord. The Lord is with you, for you are chosen and blessed among women. VerseEnd Verse29 And when she saw the angel, she was troubled at his saying, and pondered in her mind what manner of salutation this should be. VerseEnd Verse30 And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary, for you have found favor with God. VerseEnd Verse31 And behold, you shall conceive, and bring forth a son, and shall call his name Jesus. VerseEnd Verse32 He shall be great and shall be called the Son of the Highest, and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David. VerseEnd Verse33 And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever, and of his kingdom there shall be no end. VerseEnd

Verse34 Then said Mary unto the angel, How can this be? VerseEnd Verse35 And the angel answered and said unto her, Of the holy ghost and the power of the Highest. Therefore also, that holy child that shall be born of you shall be called the Son of God. VerseEnd Verse36 And behold, your kinswoman Elizabeth, she has also conceived a son in her old age, and this is the sixth month with her who is called barren; VerseEnd Verse37 for with God, nothing can be impossible. VerseEnd Verse38 And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to your word. And the angel departed from her. VerseEnd

Verse39 And in those days, Mary went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah, VerseEnd Verse40 and entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elizabeth. VerseEnd Verse41 And it came to pass that when Elizabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb. And Elizabeth was filled with the holy ghost, VerseEnd Verse42 and she spoke out with a loud voice and said, Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb! VerseEnd Verse43 And why is it that this blessing is upon me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me? VerseEnd Verse44 For behold, as soon as the voice of your salutation sounded in my ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy. VerseEnd Verse45 And blessed are you who believed, for those things which were told you of the angel of the Lord shall be fulfilled. VerseEnd

Verse46 And Mary said, My soul does magnify the Lord, VerseEnd Verse47 and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior, VerseEnd Verse48 for he has regarded the low estate of his handmaiden. For behold, from henceforth, all generations shall call me blessed, VerseEnd Verse49 for he who is mighty has done to me great things, and I will magnify his holy name VerseEnd Verse50 for his mercy on those who fear him from generation to generation. VerseEnd Verse51 He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts. VerseEnd Verse52 He has put down the mighty from their high seats, and exalted them of low degree. VerseEnd Verse53 He has filled the hungry with good things, but the rich he has sent away empty. VerseEnd Verse54 He has helped his servant Israel in remembrance of mercy, VerseEnd Verse55 as he spoke to our fathers — to Abraham and to his seed for ever. VerseEnd Verse56 And Mary abided with Elizabeth about three months and returned to her own house. VerseEnd

Verse57 And now Elizabeth’s full time came that she should be delivered, and she brought forth a son. VerseEnd Verse58 And her neighbors and her kinsmen heard how the Lord had shown great mercy unto her, and they rejoiced with her. VerseEnd Verse59 And it came to pass that on the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child, and they called him Zacharias after the name of his father. VerseEnd Verse60 And his mother answered and said, Not so, but he shall be called John. VerseEnd Verse61 And they said unto her, There is none of your kindred that is called by this name. VerseEnd Verse62 And they made signs to his father and asked him how he would have him called. VerseEnd Verse63 And he asked for a writing table and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they all marveled. VerseEnd Verse64 And his mouth was opened immediately, and he spoke with his tongue and praised God, VerseEnd Verse65 and fear came on all who dwelled round about them. And all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judea. VerseEnd Verse66 And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be? And the hand of the Lord was with it. VerseEnd

Verse67 And its father Zacharias was filled with the holy ghost and prophesied, saying, VerseEnd Verse68 Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people, VerseEnd Verse69 and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David, VerseEnd Verse70 as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets ever since the world began, VerseEnd Verse71 that we should be saved from our enemies and from the hand of all those who hate us, VerseEnd Verse72 to perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant, VerseEnd Verse73 the oath which he swore to our father Abraham, VerseEnd Verse74 that he would grant unto us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, might serve him without fear, VerseEnd Verse75 in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our lives. VerseEnd Verse76 And you, child, shall be called the prophet of the Highest, for you shall go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways, VerseEnd Verse77 to give knowledge of salvation unto his people by baptism for the remission of their sins, VerseEnd Verse78 through the tender mercy of our God whereby the daybreak from on high has visited us, VerseEnd Verse79 to give light to them who sit in darkness and the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace. VerseEnd
Verse80 And the child grew and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts until the day of his showing unto Israel. VerseEnd
